'''Wilkadon''' was a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] who governed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Askaj/Legends|Askaj]].<ref name="TG" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] was dispatched to [[Mission to Askaj|capture]] Wilkadon while he was on the planet for his annual [[tomuon]] holdings inspection, but the theft of the painting ''[[Killik Twilight]]'', which held the [[Shadowcast]] transmission codes, nearly scuppered the mission.<ref name="TG" />
